upstream=[]

    upstream.append({'root':str(original),'members':len(m['artifacts']),'manifest_sha256':expected,'raw_members_unchanged':True})
git('diff','--exit-code','6d85742b0114cc5e304e88b2aa930755ccce9bc9','--','sdk/python');git('diff','--cached','--check')

print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in proof.items() if k not in {'files','staged_paths','upstream'}}));print(json.dumps({'proof_sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'upstream':upstream}))
